Name: Vex Scar Fairy Trinket
Author: cgyfhb
Description:
[center][size=3][u]This mod will:[/u]

- Replace the fairy trinket sprites (and all of its color variants) so you get a cute little Scar following you around instead!

- Replace the Fairy Box sprite with a Minecraft-inspired chest (the chest monster follows him everywhere unfortunately)

~~~~~~~~

[u]Requirements:

[/u]You will need to download both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ in order for this mod to work.

[/size][size=3]~~~~~~~~
[/size][size=3]
[u]Important Disclaimer:

[/u]I am NOT a modder, just really insane about Scar. I've not run into any issues on my end, but if you're having trouble with anything please DM me on [url=https://x.com/cgyfhb]Twitter[/url]﻿!
[size=3]
[/size][size=3]~~~~~~~~[/size]

[u]Additional Notes:[/u]

The hair used in the second image is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2869]Coii's Hair Sets Pack[/url]﻿.
The sleeves used in the second image is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15431]SH's Gloves and Sleeves Pack[/url]﻿.
Although nothing from this is used in the second image, its fun to pair this mod with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31919]Grian Fashion[/url]﻿.[/size][/center][size=3]
[/size]
